title: headwater-error/1
description: What any command prints under `--json` when it fails: the command, its exit code and what is wrong, each problem in the shape of `validate --json`. Example: `headwater contributions project/none --json`.

command.description: The command that ran: `contributions`, or `database import-excel` for a command of a group. Empty when the command line names none.

exit_code.description: The exit code of the command, 1 or 2. A usage error exits with 2.

errors.description: The problems of invalid data, else one problem whose code is the error's class in kebab case (`singular-matrix`), `error` for a plain headwater error, or `usage` for a usage error.

code.description: Stable, so tools can match on it: `supplier-not-found`.

item.description: What is wrong: `tshirt:tshirt line e02`, or `flow toy:n2o`.

location.description: A file and a row, when known: `exchanges.csv:3`.

text.description: The line `validate` prints: item, message, and the location in brackets.
